theme: Last day with the four girls — open and unhurried
greeting: A wide-open Halloween Saturday, Dan. The four girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete for one more day before tomorrow's handoff to Jen, and nothing sits on the calendar until the 9 AM review with Mike in the morning.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has sat open since mid-September. Holiday inventory at PWM is the thinnest of the year, so a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December trip undecided
needsAttention.detail: The three-week December break for all six has run past both its Sep 30 decide-by and Oct 15 book-by dates; holiday inventory for a group of that size thins a little more every day it waits.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike, 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute board sweep lands tomorrow morning, and the Christmas rental and December trip are exactly the stalled items it exists to chase — worth arriving with a call on each.
